hadith:
Companions of the Prophet - Narrated Alqama:

I went to Sham and was offering a two-rak`at prayer; I said, "O Allah! Bless me with a (pious) companion." Then I saw an old man coming towards me, and when he came near I said, (to myself), "I hope Allah has given me my request." The man asked (me), "Where are you from?" I replied, "I am from the people of Kufa." He said, "Weren't there amongst you the Carrier of the (Prophet's) shoes, Siwak and the ablution water container? Weren't there amongst you the man who was given Allah's Refuge from the Satan? And weren't there amongst you the man who used to keep the (Prophet's) secrets which nobody else knew? How did Ibn Um `Abd (i.e. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud) use to recite Surat-al-lail (the Night:92)?" I recited:-- "By the Night as it envelops By the Day as it appears in brightness. And by male and female." (92.1- 3) On that, Abu Darda said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me read the Verse in this way after listening to him, but these people (of Sham) tried their best to let me say something different."
message: Allah is the sole deity worthy of worship, and to Him all praise belongs in this life and the hereafter. Since He is Al-Muhsi, the All-Enumerating, He is fully aware of every action and deed we perform, so we should strive to live with consciousness of His presence and accountability. Let this awareness inspire us to maintain sincere devotion and righteous conduct, knowing that nothing escapes His knowledge and everything will be accounted for on the Day of Judgment.
name:
Al Muhsi - الْمُحْصِي - The All-Enumerating

The name Al Muhsi signifies Allah’s attribute of being fully aware of everything that exists, counting all actions and deeds, ensuring nothing is overlooked. This name emphasizes the concept of accountability in the hereafter, where every action will be recorded and judged. The origin of this name is from the Arabic root 'حَصَرَ' which means to enumerate or count.
verse:
Al-Qasas - The Stories - 28:70

He is Allah. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. All praise belongs to Him in this life and the next. All authority is His. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.
